# Oddly Satisfying Motion, for AI coding agents
You are adding Oddly Satisfying Motion to a SwiftUI iOS app (minimum iOS 16). Rules:
- Copy files verbatim. Do not modify them, do not add a package.
- WowCore.swift is required once per app target. Units depend only on it.
- Style is injected via parameters; never hard-code colors in the unit files.
- Respect Reduce Motion and keep haptics optional (already handled inside the files).
Available units (id, one line, entry point):
- press - Touch-down acknowledgement with system-button states: scale + dim and one .tap haptic per touch, silent cancel on drag-out and re-entry, spring back on release, snap back when the system takes the touch. - WowPressStyle / .wowPress()
- success-check - Completion confirmed: circle scales in, checkmark draws with trim, .success haptic lands as the stroke completes. - WowSuccessCheck
- reward-burst - Reward from the button that earned it: 12-40 particles with mass, drag, rotation and gravity, one tint with brightness variation, gone within ~1 s. .burst haptic first. - WowRewardBurst / .wowRewardBurst(trigger:)
- loading-morph - The button owns the wait: the label blurs into the system spinner, then the result glyph springs in, all inside one fixed frame. No haptic on entering loading; .success lands as the checkmark settles (+0.18 s), .error fires at once. - WowLoadingMorph
- hold-fill - Hold to confirm: the label fills leading to trailing, linear over 2 s, while the finger stays down; .success and the action land on the frame the fill completes. Lifting early or leaving the label retracts it in 0.2 s. - WowHoldFill / .wowHoldFill(onConfirm:)
- icon-swap - Copy → Copied: the glyph swaps to a checkmark (SF Symbols Replace on iOS 17+, spring cross-fade on 16), .success haptic lands as the checkmark appears, then it swaps back on its own, silently. - WowIconSwap
- label-roll - Numbers and labels roll in the direction of change: up when the value rises, down when it falls, so the sign reads before the digits do. Monospaced digits hold the width. Silent on ordinary changes; one .tap only when a threshold you care about is crossed. - WowLabelRoll / WowLabelRollText
- failure-shake - Validation failed: one horizontal damped shake (+8, −6, +4, −2 pt, at rest again in 0.40 s) with the .error haptic on the first frame, and an optional destructive tint for the length of the shake. Only for a real rejection, never to draw attention. - WowFailureShake / .wowFailureShake(trigger:)
Fetch a unit's full prompt at /units/<id>/prompt.md and the raw Swift at /files/<FileName>.swift, relative to the site you copied this from (the host is not known at build time).
